frozen: 全部 Arrhenius（除 f_gas 作用的 C+H2O/C+CO2 指前因子）

parameters.kappa: inlet O2 multiplier; O/C coordination factor; not attributed to a meter
parameters.xi_mol_s: post-reactor WGS extent; does not enter the reactor solve; X_C unchanged
parameters.ln_f_gas: log multiplier on shared C+H2O / C+CO2 prefactor

observations.sigma_note: predeclared pilot weights, not measurement uncertainty
observations.X_C: xc_measured_pct from P1.8-D (measured carrier, calibrated syngas, recon coal)
observations.composition: analyzer = P1.7-A baseline plant vol%; liu_phase = Liu 2023 table 3
observations.H_ledger: num = 2 F_H2_shifted [+ 4 CH4 + 2 H2S]; den = 2 plant_dry y_H2; 2ξ counted once
observations.T_eq: proxy: Q from shifted CO/H2/CO2 and reactor-outlet H2O; quench replaces ξ mol H2O

optimizer.jacobian: custom 2-point finite difference on scaled residuals
optimizer.covariance: (J^T J)^{-1} in native units (local curvature); also J @ diag(x_scale)

predeclared.P1: scaled RMS ≤ 1 → reaches predeclared fit tolerance (pilot weights, not measurement σ)
predeclared.P2: HISTORICAL as run: cond(J)<100 and all |ρ|<0.9 in native parameter units (ξ mol/s); observation residuals scaled by σ. Result 0/26. Not generalized.
predeclared.P3: within-phase scatter vs curvature 1σ; analyzer vs liu Δθ vs curvature 1σ; phase median/range
predeclared.P4: flags only: κ in [0.92,1.03]; f_gas in [1/16,2]; T_eq proxy in [500,1300] K under quench-replaces-ξ water assumption; bound hits
predeclared.P5: redo phase fits at L_wsr=4 m, HL_tot in {0.5,1.5}%; report Δθ/curvature 1σ
predeclared.P6: non-unique if cost differs <1% but some parameter differs by > each curvature 1σ
predeclared.P7: within-phase LOO vs uncorrected vs residual patch; report only; Liu targets identical across windows in a phase

post_hoc.P2_local_xscale: Review revision, not predeclared: cond(J @ diag(0.05,50,1))<100 and |ρ|<0.9 as a local curvature/collinearity screen. Passing this threshold is not global identifiability. Bound solutions listed separately.
